program='''from collections import Counter, deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen = set()\n    components = []\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:\n                continue\n            q = deque([(r, c)])\n            seen.add((r, c))\n            comp = []\n            while q:\n                y, x = q.popleft()\n                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))\n                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] != background:\n                        seen.add((yy,xx))\n                        q.append((yy,xx))\n            components.append(comp)\n    seed = max(components, key=len)\n    seed_coords = {(r,c) for r,c,_ in seed}\n    outside = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)\n                      if grid[r][c] != background and (r,c) not in seed_coords)\n    marker = outside.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    cr = sum(r for r,c,v in seed) / len(seed)\n    cc = sum(c for r,c,v in seed) / len(seed)\n    ar, ac, _ = min(seed, key=lambda p: (p[0]-cr)**2 + (p[1]-cc)**2)\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == marker and (r,c) not in seed_coords:\n                for sr, sc, color in seed:\n                    rr, xx = r + sr-ar, c + sc-ac\n                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= xx < w:\n                        out[rr][xx] = color\n    return out\n'''

            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] != background:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            components.append(comp)
    seed = max(components, key=len)
    seed_coords = {(r,c) for r,c,_ in seed}
    outside = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                      if grid[r][c] != background and (r,c) not in seed_coords)
    marker = outside.most_common(1)[0][0]
